crossRefs.note: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;
“ ‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against…
Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now…
He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you…
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
“If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass…

translations.web: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.
translations.bsb: and must confess the sin he has committed. He must make full restitution, add a fifth to its value, and give all this to the one he has wronged.
translations.kjv: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
translations.asv: then he shall confess his sin which he hath done: and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him in respect of whom he hath been guilty.
